exposure: antibiotic administration for isolated maternal fever during labor
expectant management for isolated maternal fever during labor
outcome: neonatal intensive care unit length of stay
cohort: Laboring women with a singleton term gestation and a single temperature of between 38.0°C and 38.9°C without other evidence of infection, at a tertiary teaching hospital.
finding: Antibiotic use for isolated maternal fever was associated with a lower rate of treatment for postpartum endometritis but a higher rate of neonatal intensive care unit admissions and 5-minute Apgar scores of <7.
followup_time: Until maternal postpartum discharge and neonatal hospital/NICU discharge
